applyTo: "src/**/*.{cpp,hpp,h,cc,cxx}"

# RenoDX C++ style guide

Before planning, reviewing, creating, or editing any matching RenoDX C++ file,
read `docs/CXX_STYLE.md` in full and follow it. Do not rely on a summary, prior
knowledge, or the fact that another instruction merely references the guide.

The guide applies to RenoDX-authored C++ under `src/`. Vendored code under
`external/` follows its upstream project.
